events.title: 🎉 Grandkids, Steam Next Fest is on! Come play Senior Survival Club!
events.summary: Steam Next Fest has begun! But in all this chaos, Grandma's little grandbaby has gone missing. It's too much for one old lady, so won't you come help me look? 🔥 Look at all these green little zombies, nothing going for them but numbers. Go on, bite me, punk.
